description: This file declares the HttpCache class, which implements an HTTP transaction factory with caching capabilities, layered on top of another factory. It manages cache backend creation, transaction handling, cache entry lifecycle, and supports features like cache splitting and testing hooks. It is part of the net namespace and references various net and base components.

classes.name: HttpCache
classes.description: Implements an HTTP transaction factory with integrated caching, managing cache backend creation, transaction lifecycle, and cache entries, supporting features like cache splitting and testing hooks.

classes.name: HttpCache::BackendFactory
classes.description: Abstract factory interface for creating cache backends used by HttpCache.

classes.name: HttpCache::DefaultBackend
classes.description: Default implementation of BackendFactory for common cache configurations, including in-memory and disk-based caches.

classes.name: HttpCache::ActiveEntry
classes.description: Represents an active cache entry, including its state, associated transactions, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: HttpCache::CreateBackend
methods.description: Creates the disk cache backend asynchronously, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: HttpCache::GetBackend
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the cache backend, returning a network error code or ERR_IO_PENDING.

methods.name: HttpCache::CreateTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP transaction with specified priority.

methods.name: HttpCache::CloseAllConnections
methods.description: Closes all active sockets to prevent reuse, for debugging purposes.

methods.name: HttpCache::CloseIdleConnections
methods.description: Closes all idle sockets not currently in use.

methods.name: HttpCache::OnExternalCacheHit
methods.description: Notifies the cache of external resource reuse.

methods.name: HttpCache::SetHttpNetworkTransactionFactoryForTesting
methods.description: Replaces the network layer for testing purposes.

methods.name: HttpCache::GenerateCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a request, considering network isolation.
